new_results.statement: If an invertible physical 3x3 principal block B has one zero diagonal entry, arbitrary outside couplings allowed, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3*2^(2/3)|det B|^(-1/3).

For rank exactly three, after fixing row u_i with c<1, if all whitened residual leverages u_j^T(I-u_i u_i^T)^(-1)u_j are <=1/2, then ||p_Q||_infinity <=3e[(1-c)|det Lambda|]^(-1/3); c<=7/8 and |det Lambda|>=1 gives <=6e.
